runs.name: two players with count retry and rough

probes.name: numeric DATA and indexed READ
probes.source:
10 DATA 1.8,0,-2,3E-2
20 DIM A(4)
30 READ A(1)\READ B
40 READ A(2),A(3)
50 PRINT A(1);B;A(2);A(3)
60 END

probes.name: DATA uses the compiled source conversion
DATA rejects an explicit leading plus
a skipped DATA statement is available
probes.source:
10 GOTO 30
20 DATA 3,1
30 READ A
40 READ B
50 PRINT A;B
60 END

probes.name: READ exhaustion halts execution
probes.source:
10 DATA 1
20 READ A
30 READ A
40 PRINT "STILL";A
50 END

probes.name: DATA sequences and RESTORE
probes.source:
10 DATA 1\DATA 2\PRINT "AFTER"
20 READ A,B\RESTORE\READ C
30 PRINT A;B;C
40 END

probes.name: marked DATA literals
probes.source:
10 DATA #N,-#Y
20 READ A,B
30 PRINT A;B
40 END

probes.name: nested loops across transfers
probes.source:
10 FOR J=1 TO 2
20 FOR Q=1 TO 2
30 IF Q=1 THEN 100
40 GOTO 120
50 PRINT J;Q;X
60 NEXT Q
70 NEXT J
80 GOTO 200
100 X=10
110 GOTO 50
120 X=20
130 GOTO 50
200 END

probes.name: restart an initialized FOR header
probes.source:
10 C=0
20 FOR I=1 TO 2
30 C=C+1
40 IF C=1 THEN 20
50 PRINT I;C
60 NEXT I
70 END

probes.name: independent FOR headers sharing a variable
probes.source:
10 S=0
20 FOR I=1 TO 2
30 IF S=1 THEN 70
40 S=1
50 GOTO 100
70 PRINT I
80 NEXT I
90 GOTO 200
100 FOR I=7 TO 8
110 PRINT I
120 NEXT I
130 GOTO 70
200 END
